breaking_changes: LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY explicitly set to empty string no longer bypasses authentication; requests to API and metrics routes return 401 unless LEMONADE_API_KEY is provided (affects misconfigured installations only).
/files endpoint for multi-shard GGUF models in extra_models_dir now returns one entry per shard instead of a single aggregated entry; clients that assumed a single response may need updating.

evidence.blockers: Two hardware-specific items require real devices before final sign-off: ROCm gfx1170/gfx1171 inference cannot be verified until AMD publishes TheRock assets for 10.1.0 (expected 10.3), so the runtime install path will fail until then; NVIDIA driver-gating logic needs a system with an NVIDIA GPU where the driver is missing or older than the minimum (525.60.13 Linux / 528.33 Windows) to confirm the unsupported/action_required paths and Vulkan fallback behave correctly.
evidence.breaking_changes: LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY set to empty string now properly enforces authentication (previously it was treated as unset, allowing access with only LEMONADE_API_KEY configured). Only misconfigured installations with a non-empty LEMONADE_API_KEY and an explicitly empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY are affected. The /files endpoint now returns one entry per shard for multi-shard GGUF models in extra_models_dir instead of a single aggregated entry; clients iterating the response expecting one entry may need updating.
evidence.coverage: 31 commits reviewed across the range v2026.46.2..c6b0006. Reviewed surface includes: ROCm GPU target additions (gfx1170/gfx1171), NVIDIA driver-missing and driver-too-old gating, authentication fix for empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY, GGUF zero-shot router support, conversation-scoped image references, multi-GPU monitor, backends metadata display, backends grid layout, image download and copy buttons, CUDA load endpoint protection for on-demand models, macOS Monitor CPU usage restoration, CLI error message improvements, multi-shard GGUF /files endpoint fix, container pin updates, model registry additions, website news entries, CI hardening, and packaging fixes. The range start v2026.46.2 to head c6b0006 was covered by the commit review digests; no commits in the range appear to be unreviewed.
evidence.manual_testing: macOS Monitor CPU gauge must be exercised with an active model to confirm the restored host_statistics sampling displays correctly and the mutex scope does not cause noticeable UI stall. Chat view image download, copy, and multi-image editing need end-to-end GUI exercise to confirm the post-approval error-handling path and unique filenames work. GGUF zero-shot router should be run end-to-end with a real model through /v1/classify to validate against the ONNX reference implementation. /v1/load must be tested with an on-demand upscaler to confirm the 400 rejection.
evidence.security: No new security concerns observed. The release includes a security fix for empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY bypassing authentication, which tightens access control for a pre-existing misconfiguration pattern. CodeQL analysis passed on all reviewed commits.
